title: fix(app-shell,i18n): the console's global Undo / Redo toasts speak the user's language (objectui#11080)
body:
Part of #11080
Clause-②: no

This PR lands the first half of objectui#11080: the two toast prefixes. The second half, the English `Undo OBJECT` description that three producers build for an operation whose action declared no `label`, is not changed here. It is stopped for a decision, because every honest way to give it one pack key changes the published `UndoableOperation` type in `@object-ui/core` (see "The half that is not here" below). The card stays open for it.

## What was wrong

`AppContent` mounts `useGlobalUndo` on every console route. Its `onUndo` and `onRedo` raised `toast.info` with a template string, `Undo: ` or `Redo: ` followed by `op.description`. Under a zh-CN session the prefix stayed English.

## What changed

- **`AppContent`** (`packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`): the two toasts read `t('actions.undoneOperation', { description: op.description })` and `t('actions.redoneOperation', { description: op.description })`. The `t` is the one `AppContent` already holds from `useObjectTranslation()`, in the same component scope as the `useGlobalUndo` call. Durations are unchanged (4000 and 3000).
- **Packs** (`packages/i18n/src/locales/*`): two new keys beside `actions.undo` / `actions.undone`, in all ten packs. The description is interpolated as `{{description}}`, so each pack owns the words and their order. The en comment names the reader.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/11080-undo-redo-toasts-i18n.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

The claim's `Clause-②: no` holds for this diff: a rendered toast string moves into the packs. No export, type, schema key or accepted set moves. `@object-ui/core` is not touched.

| pack | `actions.undoneOperation` | `actions.redoneOperation` |
|---|---|---|
| en | `Undo: {{description}}` | `Redo: {{description}}` |
| zh | `撤销：{{description}}` | `重做：{{description}}` |
| ja | `元に戻す: {{description}}` | `やり直す: {{description}}` |
| ko | `실행 취소: {{description}}` | `다시 실행: {{description}}` |
| de | `Rückgängig: {{description}}` | `Wiederholen: {{description}}` |
| fr | `Annuler : {{description}}` | `Rétablir : {{description}}` |
| es | `Deshacer: {{description}}` | `Rehacer: {{description}}` |
| pt | `Desfazer: {{description}}` | `Refazer: {{description}}` |
| ru | `Отменить: {{description}}` | `Повторить: {{description}}` |
| ar | `تراجع: {{description}}` | `إعادة: {{description}}` |

Wording: each pack's own `actions.undo`, its own word for Redo (the value its other `redo` keys already use), and the colon style that pack already uses before a placeholder (full-width in zh, a space before the colon in fr). en is byte-equal to the old text.

## Pins

`packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.undoRedoToast-11080.test.tsx` renders the real `AppContent` under a real `I18nProvider`, with the real `useGlobalUndo`. Routing is reduced to the zero-app empty state, the same reduction as `AppContent.noAppsCta.test.tsx`. Each case pushes an `update` operation onto the real `globalUndoManager` and presses the real shortcut on `window`. The hook writes through the adapter, and the toast that follows is asserted.

- zh, Ctrl+Z: `撤销：Complete`, duration 4000, after the adapter's `update` wrote the undo data.
- zh, Ctrl+Shift+Z: `重做：Complete`, duration 3000, after the redo write.
- en control: `Undo: Complete`, then `Redo: Complete`.
- An authored label (`标记为赢单 & notify "owner"`) reaches both zh toasts byte for byte, unescaped. An operation's description IS the action's label when the action declared one.

**Ablation** (fix committed first as `f6c731d42`; mutation and restore through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, with a `trap` restore as well):
- Leg 1 put the undo toast back to the English template. The anchor hit 1 time, then 0; the blob moved from `e29dc9b2d04a` to `436274c085a1`. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`. The zh undo case read `Undo: Complete` for `撤销：Complete`, and the label case read `Undo: 标记为赢单 …`. The en control and the zh redo case stayed green, as expected.
- Leg 2 did the same to the redo toast. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`: the zh redo case and the label case.
- Restore: the blob is back to `e29dc9b2d04a`, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty (0 bytes).

## Gates (run at `fffdda500`, the branch head)

- Tests: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `packages/app-shell/src/console/`, `packages/i18n/`, `packages/core/src/actions/`, the two `useGlobalUndo` pins in `packages/react`, the six undo pins in app-shell (`undoneToast-11056`, `undoLookupId-11122`, `undoCapture-11082`, `undoAbsentField-10404`), `plugin-grid`'s `undoProjectedRow-10404`, and `apps/console`'s two `AppContent` suites. Result: `Test Files 217 passed (217)`, `Tests 2431 passed | 13 skipped (2444)`.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n --concurrency=2`, which builds the `^build` closure first: `Tasks: 31 successful, 31 total`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` in app-shell lists both the new pin and `AppContent.tsx`.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the 12 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors, 35 warnings, none on a changed line (the existing `no-explicit-any` / `react-hooks` warnings in `AppContent.tsx`). This is a narrowing, and it is sound: 12 files are counted in the `--format json` output, `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService` (no type-aware linting), and no rule in it or in `eslint-rules/` reads another file from disk, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

I read each paragraph. They describe the expression-user normaliser and the `console.nav` strings, and this diff falsifies none of them.

## The half that is not here: one key for the unlabelled description

The producers are `ActionRunner`'s `executeUpdateOperation` in `@object-ui/core`, the console runtime's `api` handler, and `RecordDetailView`'s `api` handler. Each writes the same expression: `action.label` or else the word Undo plus the object's API name. What was measured at `f75e1f7e0`:

1. `UndoableOperation.description` is a required `string` on a published type. `@object-ui/core` exports it through `actions/index.ts`, it types `ActionResult.undo`, and `useGlobalUndo`'s `onUndo` / `onRedo` hand it to callers.
2. `@object-ui/core` has no translator of its own. `ActionRunner.setTranslator` exists, and both React owners install one, but its options type carries only `defaultValue` (no interpolation values), and its pattern keeps an English `defaultValue` in core. The dispatch rules out an English literal left in core as the rendered fallback.
3. The two shapes the dispatch offered both move the op type. One is the op carrying the untranslated parts, with `description` absent or a key plus the object. The other is core returning a descriptor that the toast resolves. Each makes `description` optional or adds a member, which widens a published type, so `Clause-②` would become yes. The dispatch says to stop and report in that case, so this PR stops here.
4. At the toast site an object label IS at hand: `useObjectLabel()`'s `objectLabel` and `useMetadata().objects` are both in `AppContent`'s scope, and `handleCrudSuccess` already renders `objectLabel(formObjectDef)`. So a toast-site fallback could show the label rather than the API name.
5. The fallback's reach is thin. `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 `ActionSchema.safeParse` rejects an action with no `label` (`invalid_union` at `label`). It accepts `label: ''`, and the labelled control parses. So the fallback shows only for an authored empty label, or for an `ActionDef` built in code.

The options and a recommendation go to the PM in the dev report on the card.

## Acceptance notes

- Not filed (dormant, zero pull): `AppContent`'s `crud_success` handler toasts the literal default `Record saved successfully` when `params.message` is absent. Its only in-repo emitter, `handleCrudSuccess`, always passes a translated message. Carrier: none.
- objectui#11081 (the one keyboard listener) and objectui#11082 (the record page's capture rule) have landed. Neither overlaps this diff: this change is inside the two handlers `AppContent` passes to `useGlobalUndo`.
